title: How did dinosaurs become birds?

author: Adam Conover
description:
It's been stressful lately on the show and in the world, so today we're taking a break from apocalyptic fascism and the AI revolution to talk about BIRDS! Isn’t that nice? Joining me today is return guest Steve Brusatte, a paleontologist, science writer, and professor at the University of Edinburgh with a new book out: The Story of Birds: A New History from Their Dinosaur Origins to the Present.
